انفهقت (form VII)

# اِنْفَهَقْتَ (infahaqta) /in.fa.haq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْفَهَقَ (infahaqa)
# اِنْفَهَقْتِ (infahaqti) /in.fa.haq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْفَهَقَ (infahaqa)
# اِنْفَهَقَتْ (infahaqat) /in.fa.ha.qat/: third-person
